title: Open detail D1a · An “are you sure?” box while it works
subtitle: From item 8; needed before Main builds the shared confirm box (item 19). Today, while a box waits for the database: most show no change at all — the button is marked busy for screen readers only, so it looks the same and the box can still be pressed or closed; Calendar's delete turns the red button gray with “Deleting…” (Prospects also says “Deleting…”); Forms, Color Belt private testing and Black Belt say “Saving…”; kiosk mode says “Opening…”. Every form dialog's Save already turns gray and says “Saving…” (approved detail 8). (Tested in the preview with a 6-second slow save set to fail, so nothing was deleted · PC size · fake data)

row.caption: 1. Color Belt's Delete permanently, while it deletes: nothing changes — the red button looks the same, and “Keep student” still works. Most boxes are like this.
2. Calendar's Delete type, while it deletes: the red button turns gray and says “Deleting…”; Cancel can still be pressed.

items.caption: 3. Every form dialog's Save while it saves: gray “Saving…” (approved detail 8); Cancel stays.

columns.label: Proposed (option B)

items.caption: 4. Option B: the pressed button grays and says what it is doing — “Deleting…”, “Undoing…”, “Withdrawing…” (the button's verb + “ing…”) — and “Keep student” grays too until it's done.

columns.note: Option C is picture 2's look in every box: the same gray “Deleting…”, but “Keep …” stays pressable — as in Calendar and the form dialogs today. Picture 4 is drawn over the real box; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: what does an “are you sure?” box show while it works?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − in most boxes nothing changes for a second or two after a tap, so a second tap is easy; the boxes that do show something use three different words.
B · Recommended: the pressed button grays and says what it is doing; “Keep …” grays too (picture 4). + he sees it's working; nothing can be tapped twice; “Keep” can't look as if it stopped a delete that is already on its way. − the box can't be closed for the second or two it works.
C · Calendar's look: the pressed button grays and says what it is doing; “Keep …” stays pressable. + the same as Calendar and the form dialogs today. − pressing “Keep” then closes the box but doesn't stop the delete.
